title: Ezio's final journey in Assassin's Creed Revelations
subject: ezio
description:
Did Ezio deserve a quiet ending? 👇

What Ezio found in Altaïr's library at Masyaf, and how his story ended in Florence. Spoilers for Assassin's Creed Revelations and Assassin's Creed: Embers.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: In 1512, Ezio opened a sealed library and found a skeleton.
It was Altaïr, Mentor of Masyaf, dead for two and a half centuries.
Ezio was in his fifties by then, thirty-six years into his war.
He left the Apple there and spoke to a descendant he'd never meet: I have lived my life as best I could.
Then he went home to Tuscany with Sofia and their children.
In 1524, while Sofia and Flavia shopped in Florence, he sat on a bench and his heart stopped.
He died in the city where it began, forty-eight years after the gallows.
